A value of 0 would be meaningless and likely cause issues rather than serving as a special 'disable' flag. 4) I verify the behavior - this knob maintains a natural numerical order where larger values indicate more available cache memory, and smaller positive values indicate less cache memory. There are no special values that fundamentally alter how this parameter works. 5) Conclusion - effective_cache_size is a regular numerical knob without special values that break natural ordering or change its core functionality.
